title: Connect authorized Event Search selection to read-only Event Inspection and safe return
goal: Provide a functional first-party browser journey that opens only a visible, server-authorized Event Search result for separate server-authorized CAP-INV-004 inspection, displays source/raw/rendered/enrichment provenance, and returns to its unchanged Search scope and result window, without claiming a live backend.
invariants: Event Search source and job retain Shared ownership; Event Inspection core remains the sole source of server-approved projection
Frontend never accepts browser-supplied access decisions as authority; each open must call a server-authorized inspection transport
No raw-derived content when raw is denied; fields and enrichments visibly retain provenance; no HTML string execution
No Case link, Artifact/Evidence promotion, Search execution from a PivotDraft or OPEN-013/014 decision resolution
Do not change frozen PR #181/#182 or ancestor #36 commits; all new code stays on a separate feature branch
security_properties: Search result must exist within current authorized result window, with matching Tenant, environment, job/run/correlation
Server response must match requested scope, cannot put raw content in a denied variant and cannot declare raw-derived fields while raw is denied
No permission-denied or stale in-flight Event inspection may leave a protected previous view; return requires revalidation
Server-side identity, source-specific field classification, browser-to-host transport and real parser are not provided and remain mandatory external integration dependencies

migration.rationale: Browser-only read-only state and presentation; no storage/migrations

rollback.strategy: Revert one browser journey commit series; existing Search and Inspection cores stay untouched
verification: Existing Event Search frontend tests still pass
No canonical model or runtime backend modified

inputs: CAP-INV-002 and CAP-INV-004 complete canonical specifications
Verified E10-INV-002G and E10-INV-004E bounded runtimes on #36, not proof of production
Accepted ENG-DEC-0001 first-party browser architecture and existing Event Search controller
outputs: Explicit backend-neutral inspect transport with correlated scope and identity
Semantic text-only renderer with separate raw/rendered and labelled derived provenance
Node adversarial regressions for foreign scope, unavailable Event, protected raw, stale responses and text injection
CI evidence on exact feature HEAD (pending until observed)
acceptance_tests: Only an authorized selected Search result can initiate a server inspection request
Originating Tenant/environment/job/run/correlation preserved and checked against inspected response
Raw denied while rendered allowed stays visible without raw inference
Source/normalized/raw-derived/enrichment values retain distinct labels and stale provenance
Return retains Search query/scope and original result window only while same Search Job/correlation remains authorized
Invalid cross-scope response, stale Search Job, revocation, forged protected raw, script text fail closed
Existing Event Search frontend suite remains green with exact-SHA Node CI; adaptive engineering checks are separately required
definition_of_ready: E10-INV-002G and E10-INV-004E VERIFIED on source foundation branch
Explicit source-owner authorization remains externally enforced
definition_of_done: Actual exact-head Node UI suite SUCCESS and integration test covers selected Event Search -> inspected Event -> return
Backend, IAM and end-to-end production status not claimed

performance_budget.rationale: Browser update must remain lightweight with bounded field counts, no measured production performance claim
metrics: inspector single Event <=256 visible fields per category, <=64 enrichments
no full-result rerender required for inspection return
